hints.title: Only Two Candidate Values
hints.text: For all dominoes to display the same value on a row, that specific value must be present on every domino, which means it must match either the top or bottom of the first domino.

hints.title: Candidate Validation
hints.text: Check if candidate value x is contained in tops[i] or bottoms[i] for every position i. If any position lacks x entirely, that candidate is invalid.

hints.title: Rotation Tally
hints.text: Count how many flips are needed to make all tops equal to x, and how many are needed for all bottoms. The answer for candidate x is the minimum of these two counts.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing all possible values from 1 to 6 works, but checking arbitrarily without candidate pruning does extra scans.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Inspecting at most two candidates (tops[0] and bottoms[0]) achieves O(N) runtime and O(1) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize that domino 0 restricts the viable target to at most 2 possible values.
